amendments.reason: Explicit legacy PCSR response framing and request identity; register reads unchanged. Regression tests: test_v10_2_pcsr_response.py.
Four optional best-effort progress events only; no change to command construction, submission, waiting, or timeout handling. Verified by AST comparison removing _freeze_emit calls.
Normalize only line-boundary NUL in raw Telnet PCSR replies. Reproduced exact user response and fragmented CR/NUL input; internal corruption remains rejected.

Last-resort probe USB recovery appended to the restart ladder (_probe_usb_devices/_probe_usb_recover + tail of _reconnect). Purely additive: PC read path (_read_all_pcs, _telnet_cmd, PCSR framing) is byte-identical; the only deletion is one log string. Scope is limited to USB devices matching configured vendor ids; the DUT is NVMe/PCIe and is not touched. v10.2 stays on the frozen baseline. Regression tests: test_v10_3_probe_recovery.py.

Sampler failure diagnostics. (a) OpenOCD stdout/stderr go to a file instead of unread PIPEs — an undrained pipe blocks OpenOCD on write once the 64 KiB buffer fills, which silently kills the telnet path after days of error lines. (b) On read failure, DP DPIDR/CTRL-STAT are logged BEFORE the sticky clear that used to erase them (read-only, throttled, exception-proof). (c) Cumulative counters (uptime/reads/reinit/reconnect). (d) Restart ladder varies adapter speed instead of repeating one setting. (e) Optional RSS/fd trend thread. PC read path (framing, parsing, success path) is unchanged — additions only; deletions are confined to _launch_openocd/_reconnect and docstrings. Diagnostics never raise into the read path. Tests: test_v10_3_sampler_diag.py.

Send-time block for (opcode, CDW value) pairs — strategy.blocked_cdw_rules. The rules are product-agnostic and live under strategy, not a product profile. Vendor 0xC0 with CDW12=0x2 permanently closes the debug port; a power cycle does not restore it (factory reset required), so the sample can no longer be sampled — the root cause behind the OpenOCD port 4444 wait timeout. 0xC0 is not a named command and only appears through opcode mutation (randint(0xC0,0xFF)), so neither CMD_SCHEMAS nor excluded_opcodes can reach it; the transport chokepoint is the only place that sees the value. The change is purely additive (81 insertions, 0 deletions): one early-return guard placed directly after the excluded_opcodes guard, before any command construction. Blocked commands return RC_SKIP, which the accounting path already treats as 'never sent' (no executions, coverage, or crash attribution). Every other transport guard, argument assembly, and rc handling is byte-identical. Frozen v10.2 hash unchanged. Tests: test_v10_3_cmd_block.py (15, real _send_nvme_command; injection-verified by removing the value comparison and the scope check).

Reviewed v11 opt-in post-Popen hook. Command construction and transport guards unchanged. Hook exists only in v11 mixin; consumed reservation time is subtracted from ordinary wait on missed injection. An explicitly preserved v11 failure does not kill the pending ioctl. Frozen v10.2 hash is unchanged. RealTransportIntegration tests exercise disabled transport, injection, PM exclusion, next-command watchdog restoration and sequence continuation using actual method with mocked Popen.

Activate v11 device-path freeze using the already reviewed v10.3 overrides. All five guarded AST paths are identical to their reviewed baselines; no hashes regenerated. v10.2/v10.3 remain frozen legacy checks. Future engine changes target v11 only.

v11.1 is a new file copied from v11 (run record, LLM share chart, CSFuzz p fix, compare tool). All five guarded AST paths are identical to the reviewed v11 baselines; no hashes regenerated. v11 stays frozen as a legacy check. Future engine changes target v11.1.

RiscvPcsrSampler: overlay bank probe failures (read fail / unresolvable word, not swaps) are counted per core; after _OVL_FAIL_LIMIT consecutive failed bursts the core's bank resolution is turned off and samples are kept as bank 0 instead of being silently dropped (field: ovl-drop 100% after recovery = zero PC collection). Streak resets on success and on re-probe at connect. Reviewed; only this class hash changes for v11.1.

_send_nvme_command: after an errno-only failure (no NVMe status) whose message is a device-loss errno (No such device / No such file / EAGAIN / EINTR / EIO), check /sys/class/nvme/<ctrl>/state (wait up to 10s for live); if the controller is gone or dead, set _device_lost_reason and return RC_TIMEOUT so the existing crash capture runs (crash_reason=device_lost) and the run stops. Field: kernel 'Disabling device after reset failure: -19' left the fuzzer looping on ENODEV. Reviewed; ordinary errno failures and live controllers are unchanged.

RiscvPcsrSampler, JLinkHaltSampler: J-Link VTref is fixed to config jlink_vtref_mv (default 1800 mV, null/0 = auto) right after pylink open and before connect/SJTAG auth; RiscvPcsrSampler only forwards the value to PcsrSession -> sfe76_link.Link.open (re-applied on every reopen). Failure to set or a read-back mismatch only logs a warning and leaves J-Link on measured VTref. Reviewed; register/sampling paths unchanged.

v11.2 is a new file copied from v11.1 (PM preflight hang/failure handling). All guarded AST paths are identical to the reviewed v11.1 overrides; no hashes regenerated. v11.1 stays frozen as a legacy check. Future engine changes target v11.2.

RiscvPcsrSampler (BM9K1 only): sampling must not delay NVMe commands. (1) stop_event is checked after every PCSR read via a Python-only stop callback passed to PcsrSession.burst (no extra DAP access/delay in the burst loop), so stop_sampling returns after at most one in-flight read instead of the rest of a ~256-read burst; an overlay core stopped mid-burst skips the end-bank read and drops those samples; a burst truncated by stop is not judged as transport failure on its own, but consecutive all-failed truncated bursts are counted across windows (_STOPPED_FAIL_LIMIT=3) and then reported as transport; the empty-burst (pin failure) streak is likewise carried across windows (_EMPTY_BURST_LIMIT) and reset by any successful pin. (2) _maybe_recover no longer reopens/re-authenticates inside the worker during a command; it sets openocd_error and the main loop recovers after the command via _stop_sampling_checked (APST/keepalive off first). No saturation early exit (it would only cut coverage; reads already stop at command end). Reviewed; PCSR register addresses, pin/unpin and read path unchanged.

RiscvPcsrSampler.connect only: sets PcsrSession.fast_switch from riscv.sample_plan.fast_switch (default true) and carries the switch counters across reconnects. The short SBA retarget path itself lives in risc-v/sjtag_unlock.sba_retarget and riscv_cov.PcsrSession.pin/read_word (keeps FIFO mode/CSW, rewrites sbaddress0 only, with mem_write32-level checks: TAR readback after every TAR write, wait for the outstanding read, posted-write flush + DP sticky check and sbaddress0 readback after the address write, completion/no sberror, TAR re-pin readback; any failure falls back to the unchanged sba_unpin→sba_pin/_sba_read path). Burst hot loop unchanged. Reviewed; not yet verified on hardware.

RiscvPcsrSampler._sampling_worker: an overlay-core burst truncated by stop_sampling now still does the end-bank read and keeps the samples when the bank is unchanged (was: dropped without the end read). With fast commands nearly every window ended mid-burst, so almost all core H samples were dropped and edge coverage vanished. Reviewed.

RiscvPcsrSampler (review follow-up): (1) _sampling_worker passes abort=stop_event.is_set to the pre-burst bank read and burst/pin; the session stops the short SBA retarget at step boundaries (never between the address write and its verification), marks the SBA state unknown and does not fall back to the full path after the command ended; an aborted setup is not counted as a pin failure. The post-burst end-bank check is not abortable (it salvages samples). (2) connect() split into _open_session() + _connect_verify() without behavior change; counters carried over now include setup_aborted/t_setup/t_read. (3) New reattach(): light reconnect after a PM detach (open session + pin + 32-sample check that valid PCs fall inside the ranges verified at first connect, gate_threshold); no ELF gate re-run, no overlay probe re-check, no settle. Any failure returns False and the caller uses the unchanged full _reconnect(). Reviewed.

RiscvPcsrSampler (review): a real pin/bank-read failure that overlaps the command end is no longer folded into 'aborted' — PcsrSession.last_setup distinguishes ok/aborted/fail, burst() reports 'aborted' only for a setup that actually stopped, and the worker counts real failures (including the pre-burst bank read) toward the cross-window setup-failure limit via _setup_failed(). reattach() checks the in-range ratio per core (WFI cores with no valid PC still allowed) instead of pooling all cores. Reviewed.

User-requested BM9K1 timeout policy: JSON group timeout times tracked PS factor (PS1=16, PS2=64, other=1), without 105ms or subprocess 2s margins. Log tracked PS and update it after successful actual admin Power Management SetFeatures. Other products keep existing timeout policy. Real transport mocked-subprocess regression tests: test_v11_2_ps_timeout.py.

User requested BM9K1 PS1 and PS2 timeout multipliers both become 10 (previously 16/64). PS0 and other products unchanged; no fixed margins added. Verified real transport deadlines in test_v11_2_ps_timeout.py.

v11.3 is a new file copied from v11.2 (FUZZER_VERSION 11.3.0) for BM9K1 opt-in background sampling. Guarded AST paths (RiscvPcsrSampler, JLinkHaltSampler, OpenOCDPCSampler, _V101Fuzzer._send_nvme_command) are byte-identical to the reviewed v11.2 overrides; no hashes regenerated. The background mode lives in a new subclass RiscvBgSampler (selected only when riscv.sample_plan.background.enabled is true, default false) and BackgroundSamplingMixin; riscv_cov.PcsrSession.burst_timed is additive (burst() unchanged). Regression tests: test_v11_3_background.py. v11.2 stays as a legacy check.

BM9K1 cJTAG speed now follows the product profile jlink_speed (BM9K1 profile stays 10000 = previous fixed SPEED_KHZ, so default behavior is unchanged); a probe with small signal margin needs a lower speed. _setup_failed adds a read-only link_diag (last MEM-AP failure reason + DP CTRL/STAT) to the 8x setup-failure log. Regression tests: test_v11_3_link_speed.py. _open_session also catches TypeError from an older riscv_cov.PcsrSession (no speed_khz) and logs which file to update instead of crashing.

_connect_verify picks candidate cores from the starting sample plan (_plan_weights) instead of the current, possibly reduced plan, so a core dropped by a transient pin/verify failure on one reconnect is restored when it passes again (previously it stayed out for the rest of the campaign and set_weights kept rejecting adaptive weights because the core set differed). Kept cores keep learned weights; cores outside the plan are never added; primary returns to the starting primary when it is back. Selection logic only; no new debug access. Regression tests: test_v11_3_core_restore.py.

_connect_verify's 'session OK' log line now also reports how many pylink.JLink objects sfe76_link has created (JLINK_CREATED; must stay 1 for the whole process) and the fuzzer RSS, so a reconnect that accumulates memory is visible in the log. Logging only; no debug access change. Paired with sfe76_link API_LEVEL 6 (one shared pylink.JLink per process) after a BM9K1 campaign was OOM-killed (anon-rss 30GB) during link_fail_por recovery: pylink loads a fresh temp copy of the J-Link DLL per JLink() when it cannot read the DLL version from the path and never unloads it on Linux. Regression tests: test_v11_3_jlink_reuse.py.

connect() reuses one process-wide pylink.JLink (_shared_pylink) instead of creating a new one per connect/reconnect; any connection left open is closed first (bounded). Same open/set_tif/connect sequence on the device. Reason: pylink loads a fresh temp copy of the J-Link DLL per JLink() when it cannot read the DLL version from the path and never unloads it on Linux, so every reconnect leaked a DLL copy (BM9K1 OOM kill 2026-10-17, same fix in sfe76_link). Regression tests: test_v11_3_jlink_reuse.py.

connect() no longer runs its own opened()-only close loop; _shared_pylink now hands over the shared pylink.JLink only after _pylink_reset really closed it (pylink keeps DLL open state and _open_refcount separately and open() skips the DLL open while the refcount is above 0, so an opened()=False/refcount>0 fault state made reconnects reuse the stale connection). If the reset cannot be confirmed the object is replaced instead of reused. Same open/set_tif/connect sequence on the device. Review follow-up; regression tests: test_v11_3_jlink_reuse.RealPylinkFaultStates.

The 'session OK' log line also reports the process's J-Link DLL executable mappings and thread count (_proc_link_stats, read from /proc/self), so hardware reconnect loops can confirm that mappings, threads and RSS stay flat, not only the pylink object count. Logging only; no debug access change. Review follow-up; tests: test_v11_3_jlink_reuse.

BM9K1 timeout multiplier uses _timeout_basis_ps(): when the tracked PS is non-operational (PS3/PS4) the basis is the most recent operational PS (0-2), since an I/O command wakes the controller back into that state (NVMe Base 8.15). Previously a PS2->PS4 sequence sent the next command with x1 (8s) while the device executed it in PS2. The [NVMe] log shows tracked and basis PS. Timeout computation and log only; the command bytes sent are unchanged. Tests: test_v11_3_ps_timeout_basis.

v11.4 is a new file copied from v11.3 (FUZZER_VERSION 11.4.0) for response-signature coverage (no-debugger feedback). Guarded AST paths carry over the v11.3 overrides unchanged; see the v11.3 amendments for each.

Adds the class flag COLLECTS_COVERAGE = True (inherited by the halt and RISC-V samplers; NullSampler declares False). The fuzzer reads it to choose PC-coverage vs response-signature logging/feedback; no debug access change. Tests: test_v11_4_response_coverage.

Records the completion time (after process spawn until communicate returns; halt samplers use the freeze-corrected firmware time) and, on success, the CQE DW0 parsed from nvme-cli 'NVMe command result:' in the first 4KB of output, for response-signature coverage. Command construction, submission, waiting and timeout handling are unchanged. Tests: test_v11_4_response_coverage.

overrides_note: hashes 는 모든 DEVICE_AST_FILES 에 적용되는 기준선이다. overrides 는 검토를 거쳐 **특정 파일에서만** 의도적으로 달라진 경로를 기록한다. v10.2 는 검증된 fallback 이라 계속 기준선 그대로여야 하고, 여기 올라오지 않은 파일·경로는 전부 기준선에 묶인다.
